title: Daṭṭhabbena
text: 3 Tisso imā bhikkhave vedanā || katamā tisso || || Sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukā vedanā || || Sukhā bhikkhave vedanā dukkhato daṭṭhabbā || dukkhā vedanā sallato daṭṭhabbā || adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato daṭṭhabbā || || 4 Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sukhā vedanā dukkhato diṭṭhā honti || dukkhā vedanā sallato diṭṭhā hoti || adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato diṭṭha hoti || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu sammaddaso acchejji taṇham vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ sammamānābhisamayā antam akāsi dukkhassā ti || || Yo sukhaṃ dukkhato adda || dukkham adakkhi sallato || adukkhamasukhaṃ santaṃ || adakkhi nam aniccato || || Sa ve sammaddaso bhikkhu || parijānāti vedanā || So vedanā pariññāya || diṭṭhadhamme anāsavo || Kāyassa bhedā dhammaṭṭho || saṅkhaṃ nupeti vedagūti || ||
